catalog_record.scope: One original first-image source, not a two-endpoint A2V guide.

takes.prompt: The same adult brown-haired anime lead singer sings this exact supplied original-song phrase with contained sincere melodic pleading. Natural sequential consonant closures, rounded vowel openings and audible-phrase breathing shape his mouth and jaw continuously; his face remains the same individual rather than a held open-mouth portrait. His microphone hand maintains a steady supported grip and natural mouth distance, and his free hand remains low and open, with a small natural finger/palm pulse. Small coherent throat, chin and eyebrow acting accompanies the original music without a large head swing, new body pose or camera move. Preserve established blue-grey eyes, tousled brown hair, light moustache and stubble, black biker jacket over burgundy shirt, round silver disc necklace and rings; no cross. The dark blue curtain, truss and soft beams remain a stable concert backdrop with no visible empty drum kit or invented figures. Same drawing style, fixed shot and natural real-time singing. Keep microphone/cable, fingers and wrist structurally coherent while the supplied voice drives varied articulation.

action_contract.story_beat: Band lead expresses the song as human performance while the narrative continues elsewhere.
action_contract.before: Established singer and supported microphone in the exact reviewed first-image framing.
action_contract.action: Articulate the supplied original phrase with varied coherent jaw/lip motion, natural breath and restrained pose-specific hand/eye acting.
action_contract.after: Same individual, microphone grip, outfit and concert framing; phrase resolves without identity or limb changes.

takes.hardware_limit: 113raw frames at24fps within the tested129-frame A2V wrapper; exact full encoded audio latent coverage required. Technical success does not grant phoneme/movement acceptance.
